'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Mali War]]
***The [[Federal Ministry of Defence (Germany)|German defence ministry]] suspends [[Bundeswehr|its military]]'s [[aerial reconnaissance]] and [[Military transport aircraft|transport]] operations in [[Mali]] after the [[government of Mali]] denied the departure of one of their flights. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-08-12/germany-suspends-military-mission-in-mali-after-troops-blocked#xj4y7vzkg (Bloomberg News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Eight people are killed and five others injured in a [[prison riot]] and shootings at a food shop and a pizzeria in [[Ciudad Juárez]], [[Chihuahua (state)|Chihuahua]]. Two other premises are set on fire. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/crime/drug-traffickers-terrorize-mexico-e2-80-99s-ciudad-ju-c3-a1rez-shootings-molotov-cocktails-and-murder/ar-AA10AKG4 (MSN)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/mexico-border-violence-juarez-deaths-el-chapo-sinaloa-cartel/ (CBS News)]
**At least a dozen vehicles are burned and several streets are blocked in the state of [[Baja California]], mainly in the cities of [[Tijuana]], [[Mexicali]] and [[Ensenada, Baja California|Ensenada]]. This is the fourth major incident in the last week where arson and blocked streets have been reported. [https://www.10news.com/news/local-news/east-county-news/fire-breaks-out-at-el-cajon-home-while-owners-are-out-of-town (KGTV)]
*[[Stabbing of Salman Rushdie]]
**[[Anglo-Indian people|Anglo-Indian]] writer [[Salman Rushdie]] is attacked at a public event in [[Chautauqua, New York]], [[United States]], sustaining multiple stab wounds to the neck and abdomen. The suspect is arrested by [[New York State Police]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/author-salman-rushdie-attacked-stage-event-new-york-sky-news-2022-08-12/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/salman-rushdie-attacked-9eae99aea82cb0d39628851ecd42227a (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**A [[Belize]]-flagged ship departs [[Chornomorsk]] for [[Turkey]], becoming the first wheat export from [[Ukraine]] under a [[United Nations]]-brokered deal. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/first-export-of-wheat-under-u-n--deal-as-two-more-ships-leave-ukraine/47821768 (Swissinfo)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 United Kingdom heat wave]]
**The [[Environment Agency]] of [[England]] declares a [[drought]] across eight of its fourteen areas amid an ongoing [[heat wave]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2022/aug/12/drought-declared-england-hosepipe-ban-water-restrictions (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2022 Oder environmental disaster]]
**A [[Mass mortality event|mass die-off]] of fish occurs in the [[Oder]] river in [[Poland]]. Polish officials call it an "ecological catastrophe" with [[Prime Minister of Poland|Prime Minister]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] vowing to "punish" those responsible. The public has been warned not to enter the water amid fears of possible contamination. [https://news.sky.com/story/tonnes-of-dead-fish-pulled-from-river-oder-in-poland-as-officials-warn-of-possible-contamination-12670933 (Sky News)]
*Three people are killed and 17 are missing after an overloaded boat capsizes in [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/boat-capsizes-crossing-river-northern-india-three-killed-17-missing-2022-08-12/ (Reuters)]
*Nine people are killed and 18 others injured after a microbus overturn in [[Minya, Egypt|Minya]], [[Egypt]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sacred-rivers-middle-east-africa-egypt-cairo-fb680335764c6f4c3dc3eeb4f9e45463 (AP)]

*[[2022 Kiribati constitutional crisis]]

*[[2022 Cetinje shooting]]
**A man kills a woman and two children at their home in [[Cetinje]], [[Montenegro]], before opening fire in the streets against random civilians, killing seven people and wounding six others.
